items.translation: 此方法不支持设置static final 字段。

items.translation: targetClass - 用于设置静态字段的目标类； 永远不为 null

items.source: In addition, several methods in this class provide support for static fields and static methods — for example, setField(Class, String, Object), getField(Class, String), invokeMethod(Class, String, Object...), invokeMethod(Object, Class, String, Object...), etc.
items.translation: 此外，该类中的几个方法为 `static` 字段和 `static` 方法提供支持——例如，setField(Class, String, Object)、getField(Class, String)、invokeMethod(Class, String, Object...)、invokeMethod(Object, Class, String, Object...) 等。

items.source: There are often times when it would be beneficial to be able to set a non-public field, invoke a non-public setter method, or invoke a non-public configuration or lifecycle callback method when testing code involving, for example:
items.translation: 在某些情况下，在测试涉及以下内容的代码时，能够设置非 `public` 字段、调用非 `public setter 方法，或调用非 `public configuration` 或 `lifecycle` 回调方法将非常有益：

items.source: This method delegates to setField(Object, Class, String, Object, Class), supplying null for the targetObject and type arguments.
items.translation: 此方法委托给setField(Object, Class, String, Object, Class)，并为targetObject和type参数提供null。

items.source: This method traverses the class hierarchy in search of the desired field. In addition, an attempt will be made to make non-public fields accessible, thus allowing one to set protected, private, and package-private fields.
items.translation: 此方法遍历类层次结构以搜索所需的字段。此外，将尝试使非 `public` 字段变为可访问的，从而允许设置 `protected`、`private` 和 包私有 字段。

items.source: This method traverses the class hierarchy in search of the desired field. In addition, an attempt will be made to make non-public fields accessible, thus allowing one to get protected, private, and package-private fields.
items.translation: 此方法遍历类层次结构以搜索所需的字段。此外，将尝试使非 `public` 字段变为可访问的，从而允许获取 `protected`、`private` 和 包私有 字段。

items.source: This method traverses the class hierarchy in search of the desired method. In addition, an attempt will be made to make non-public methods accessible, thus allowing one to invoke protected, private, and package-private setter methods.
items.translation: 此方法遍历类层次结构以查找所需的方法。此外，将尝试使非`public`方法可访问，从而允许调用`protected`、`private`和包私有（package-private）的 setter 方法。

items.source: This method traverses the class hierarchy in search of the desired method. In addition, an attempt will be made to make non-public methods accessible, thus allowing one to invoke protected, private, and package-private getter methods.
items.translation: 此方法遍历类层次结构以查找所需的方法。此外，将尝试使非`public`方法可访问，从而允许调用`protected`、`private`和包私有（package-private）的getter 方法。

items.source: This method traverses the class hierarchy in search of the desired method. In addition, an attempt will be made to make non-public methods accessible, thus allowing one to invoke protected, private, and package-private methods.
items.translation: 此方法遍历类层次结构以查找所需的方法。此外，将尝试使非`public`方法可访问，从而允许调用`protected`、`private`和包私有方法。

items.source: This method delegates to setField(Object, String, Object, Class), supplying null for the type argument.
items.translation: 此方法委托给setField(Object, String, Object, Class)，并为type参数提供null。

items.source: This method delegates to setField(Object, Class, String, Object, Class), supplying null for the targetClass argument.
items.translation: 此方法委托给setField(Object, Class, String, Object, Class)，并为targetClass参数提供null。

items.source: This method delegates to setField(Object, Class, String, Object, Class), supplying null for the targetObject argument.
items.translation: 此方法委托给setField(Object, Class, String, Object, Class)，并为targetObject参数提供null。

items.source: This method delegates to getField(Object, Class, String), supplying null for the targetClass argument.
items.translation: 此方法委托给getField(Object, Class, String)，并为targetClass参数提供null。

items.source: This method delegates to getField(Object, Class, String), supplying null for the targetObject argument.
items.translation: 此方法委托给getField(Object, Class, String)，并为targetObject参数提供null。

items.source: This method also supports JavaBean-style property names. For example, if you wish to set the name property on the target object, you may pass either "name" or "setName" as the method name.
items.translation: 此方法还支持 JavaBean 风格的属性名称。例如，如果您要在目标对象上设置name属性，可以传递"name"或"setName"作为方法名。

items.source: This method also supports JavaBean-style property names. For example, if you wish to get the name property on the target object, you may pass either "name" or "getName" as the method name.
items.translation: 此方法还支持 JavaBean 风格的属性名称。例如，如果您希望获取目标对象上的name属性，您可以将"name"或"getName"作为方法名传递。

items.source: This method delegates to invokeMethod(Object, Class, String, Object...), supplying null for the targetClass argument.
items.translation: 此方法委托给invokeMethod(Object, Class, String, Object...)，并为targetClass参数提供null。

items.source: This method delegates to invokeMethod(Object, Class, String, Object...), supplying null for the targetObject argument.
items.translation: 此方法委托给invokeMethod(Object, Class, String, Object...)，并为targetObject参数提供null。

items.source: If the supplied targetObject is a proxy, it will be unwrapped allowing the field to be set on the ultimate target of the proxy.
items.translation: 如果提供的 `targetObject` 是一个 代理，它将被 解包，从而允许在该代理的终极目标上设置该字段。

items.source: If the supplied targetObject is a proxy, it will be unwrapped allowing the field to be retrieved from the ultimate target of the proxy.
items.translation: 如果提供的 `targetObject` 是一个 代理，它将被 解包，从而允许从代理的最终目标中检索该字段。

items.source: This method delegates to invokeSetterMethod(Object, String, Object, Class), supplying null for the parameter type.
items.translation: 此方法委托给invokeSetterMethod(Object, String, Object, Class)，并传入null作为参数类型。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 6.2, if the supplied target object is a CGLIB proxy which does not intercept the setter method, the proxy will be unwrapped allowing the setter method to be invoked directly on the ultimate target of the proxy.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 6.2 起，如果提供的目标对象是一个未拦截 setter 方法的 CGLIB 代理，该代理将被解包，从而允许直接在代理的最终目标上调用 setter 方法。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 6.2, if the supplied target object is a CGLIB proxy which does not intercept the getter method, the proxy will be unwrapped allowing the getter method to be invoked directly on the ultimate target of the proxy.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 6.2 起，如果提供的目标对象是一个未拦截 getter 方法的 CGLIB 代理，该代理将被解包，从而允许直接在代理的最终目标上调用 getter 方法。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 6.2, if the supplied target object is a CGLIB proxy which does not intercept the method, the proxy will be unwrapped allowing the method to be invoked directly on the ultimate target of the proxy.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 6.2 起，如果提供的目标对象是一个未拦截该方法的 CGLIB 代理，则该代理将被解包，从而允许直接在代理的最终目标上调用该方法。

items.source: Invoke the setter method with the given name on the supplied target object with the supplied value.
items.translation: 在提供的目标对象上，使用给定的value调用具有给定name的 setter 方法。

items.source: Spring's support for annotations such as @Autowired, @Inject, and @Resource which provides dependency injection for private or protected fields, setter methods, and configuration methods.
items.translation: Spring 支持诸如@Autowired、@Inject和@Resource等注解，这些注解可为private或protected字段、setter 方法和配置方法提供依赖注入。

items.source: ORM frameworks such as JPA and Hibernate which condone the usage of private or protected field access as opposed to public setter methods for properties in a domain entity.
items.translation: 像 JPA 和 Hibernate 这样的 ORM 框架允许在域实体中为属性使用`private`或`protected`字段访问，而不是使用`public`setter 方法。

items.source: Use of annotations such as @PostConstruct and @PreDestroy for lifecycle callback methods.
items.translation: 使用诸如@PostConstruct和@PreDestroy等注解用于生命周期回调方法。

items.translation: target - 要调用指定方法的目標對象

items.translation: targetClass - 要调用指定方法的目標類別

items.translation: 调用返回的值

items.source: Set the field with the given name/type on the provided targetObject/targetClass to the supplied value.
items.translation: 设置提供的 `targetObject`/`targetClass` 上具有给定 `name`/`type` 的 field 为提供的 `value`。

items.source: Set the static field with the given name/type on the provided targetClass to the supplied value.
items.translation: 将给定的 `name`/type 的静态 field 设置到提供的 `targetClass` 上，值为提供的 `value`。

items.source: Set the field with the given name/type on the provided targetObject to the supplied value.
items.translation: 将给定 `name`/`type` 的field设置到提供的 `targetObject`》上的指定 `value`。`

items.source: Get the value of the field with the given name from the provided targetObject/targetClass.
items.translation: 获取给定 `name` 的 field，从提供的 `targetObject`/<`code>targetClass 中。

items.source: Set the static field with the given name on the provided targetClass to the supplied value.
items.translation: 将给定的 `name` 的静态 field 设置到提供的 targetClass 上，值为提供的 value。

items.source: Set the field with the given name on the provided targetObject to the supplied value.
items.translation: 将给定 `name` 的field设置到提供的 `targetObject` 上，值为提供的 `value`。

items.translation: 获取给定 `name` 的静态 field 的值，该值来自提供的 `targetClass`。

items.source: Get the value of the field with the given name from the provided targetObject.
items.translation: 获取给定 `name` 的field的值，该值来自提供的 `targetObject`。

items.source: Invoke the method with the given name on the provided targetObject/targetClass with the supplied arguments.
items.translation: 在提供的 `targetObject`/targetClass`上，使用给定的参数调用具有指定 `name` 的方法。

items.source: Invoke the getter method with the given name on the supplied target object with the supplied value.
items.translation: 在提供的目标对象上，使用给定的value调用具有给定name的getter 方法。

items.source: Invoke the static method with the given name on the supplied target class with the supplied arguments.
items.translation: 调用给定name的静态方法，在提供的目标类上使用提供的参数。

items.source: Invoke the method with the given name on the supplied target object with the supplied arguments.
items.translation: 在提供的目标对象上，使用提供的参数调用给定name的方法。
